candidate_role: bounded route and evidence extraction only
baseline_requirements: Beat the frozen deterministic router on expert-reviewed route accuracy and tool F1.
Beat the zero-shot Qwen3.5 0.8B compact candidate on every required quality metric.
Show no regression on short, mobile, map-first, advisor-narrative, and missing-evidence formats.
runtime_invariants: Model output must pass the compact JSON schema before compilation.
Only deterministic code may compile evidence codes to internal tool names.
Deterministic policy may add safety guards and may reject or replace the learned route.
Any schema failure, unknown code, critical-tool omission, or low-confidence conflict falls back to the deterministic router.
No task-rabbit output is rendered as agronomic advice.
